title: Hold a tobacco retail licence
what: Sell tobacco products by retail only from premises specified in a tobacco retail licence.

sources.title: Tobacco Control Act 2002 (NT)
sources.quote: A person must not sell a tobacco product by retail unless: (a) the person sells the tobacco product in, on or from premises specified in a tobacco retail licence; and
